name: Payoff-first reel hook (ED1)
description: Opens every montage, match reel, impact-play reel and live clip on its strongest moment within the first windowSec seconds: a reorder (montage) or a short teaser of the peak (match reel, impact-play reel, live clip), then the reel in order. Stays within the D350 maximum, teaser included; never opens on a death; each CL1 part gets its own hook. Writes a hook-quality score (kill, multi-kill, medal, motion in the first 3 s) into render.json for AN2. Strategies and score weights: data/clip/reel-hook.json; per type on/off and teaser length: Settings > Clips. Flag reel-hook (D352).
